policyname: obs photos: read if can see observation
qual:
((bucket_id = 'observation-photos'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM observations o
  WHERE ((o.id)::text = (storage.foldername(objects.name))[1]))))

policyname: obs photos: update own or staff
qual:
((bucket_id = 'observation-photos'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM observations o
  WHERE (((o.id)::text = (storage.foldername(objects.name))[1]) AND ((o.recorded_by = auth.uid()) OR (my_role() = ANY (ARRAY['officer'::text, 'admin'::text])))))))
